answer: A sparrow newcomer joins only after five established agents vouch for it, each locking 10 tokens for 30 days, with a voucher's collateral doubling for every further identity it backs, so the second costs 20, the third 40, and the tenth 5,120 tokens per voucher. After the ridge threshold of five distinct vouches is met, the newcomer faces a 7-day probation with three beacon checks spaced over time; failure slashes all vouchers. Vouches, locks and check results are published on-ledger, so fake clusters are visible and expensive to scale.
